lemmas.name: step43
lemmas.proof:
by intro i acc h
  have key : ∀ j : Nat, 12*j^2+14*j ≤ 7+24*j^3 := by
    intro j; rcases j with _|j
    · simp
    · ring_nf; omega
  have e : ∀ j : Nat, ((7+24*j^3-12*j^2-14*j : Nat) : Int) = 7+24*(j:Int)^3-12*(j:Int)^2-14*(j:Int) := by
    intro j
    have := key j
    have h1 : 12*j^2 ≤ 7+24*j^3 := by omega
    rw [Nat.cast_sub (by omega), Nat.cast_sub h1]; push_cast; ring
  have hz : (15:Int)*acc = i*(2*i+1)*(7+24*(i:Int)^3-12*(i:Int)^2-14*(i:Int)) := by
    have := congrArg (fun x : Nat => (x : Int)) h
    simp only [Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat, e] at this
    push_cast at this
    exact this
  have goal : ((15*(acc + (2*i+1)^4) : Nat) : Int) = (((i+1)*(2*(i+1)+1)*(7+24*(i+1)^3-12*(i+1)^2-14*(i+1)) : Nat) : Int) := by
    have e1 := e (i+1)
    push_cast at e1 ⊢
    rw [e1]
    push_cast
    nlinarith [hz]
  exact_mod_cast goal
